name: Face Detection Benchmark (using a face recognition database)
description: A benchmark evaluating face detection performance using images drawn from a face recognition database.
reputation: Historically used in biometrics research for evaluating face detectors but largely superseded by larger modern benchmarks (e.g., WIDER FACE).
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on face detection; dataset is older and more constrained in pose/lighting than modern benchmarks, so results may be saturated on easy subsets and not reflect in-the-wild performance.
